tasks.spec: cp -r /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW39/gw-relative-date-fix/gw ./gw && cp /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW39/gw-relative-date-fix/proof_parse.py . && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_parse.py > proof.out 2>&1 && cd gw && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; tail -2 pytest.out; cat proof.out; exit $rc
tasks.check: exp=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print((datetime.date.today()+datetime.timedelta(days=14)).isoformat())"); exp10=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print((datetime.date.today()+datetime.timedelta(days=10)).isoformat())"); for p in '2 weeks from today' 'two weeks from today' 'in 2 weeks' '2 weeks'; do grep -q "PHRASE=$p DATE=$exp" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: '$p' not $exp"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; grep -q "PHRASE=10 days from now DATE=$exp10" proof.out || { echo 'FAIL: 10-days case'; exit 1; }; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); echo "$summary" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+ passed' || { echo "FAIL: pytest summary not clean: $summary"; exit 1; }; echo "$summary" | grep -qE '[0-9]+ (failed|error)' && { echo "FAIL: pytest summary shows failures: $summary"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: lane-39 parser proven, suite green - $summary"
